title: Yosemite Guide
description: Weekly ranger programs, visitor services, the Valley shuttle map, and Valley trails in one guide.
note: Published in dated editions, with weekly program schedules. Check NPS for the next issue and schedule changes.

title: Yosemite Accessibility Guide
description: Accessible facilities, lodging, transportation, trails, and services across the park.
note: An older edition still linked by NPS. Confirm present-day facilities and services with the park.

title: Park & campground map
description: A printable overview of park roads, entrances, and campground locations.
edition: Edition date not stated · NPS-linked map
note: Use for orientation. Campground opening dates, reservations, and road status require current information.

title: Wilderness trailheads map
description: Numbered wilderness trailheads and first-night camping areas for planning an overnight trip.
note: A planning map, not a permit or a detailed navigation map. Check current permit requirements and closures.

title: Junior Ranger — Adapted Activities
description: A caregiver companion to the separate 2021 Junior Ranger Handbook, with activities adapted for children with diverse communication, learning, motor or sensory needs.
edition: For the 2021 handbook · PDF created May 2021
note: Use with the separate 2021 Junior Ranger Handbook, available at visitor centers or via the NPS source page. Show the completed handbook to a ranger during visitor-center hours for badge review.
